findings.meaning: Unit-token aliasing: when a mob targets me, targettarget (and often nameplate/softenemy) refers to the same unit as player, so every player signal is duplicated on those tokens. Mining collapses aliases to a canonical token before scoring; this row reports the aliasing itself.
findings.proposedRule: Offline: canonicalize tokens via same-frame payload identity + Ledger token→GUID before mining. Live: Ledger already caches token→GUID; avoid double-counting aliased tokens in attribution.
